list.title: Sales quotes
list.description: Quotes given to customers, their status and revisions.

actions.failed: The action could not be completed.

send.title: Send the quote?
send.body: {{number}} is marked as sent; after that it can no longer be edited, only revised.

accept.title: Was the quote accepted?
accept.body: {{number}} is marked as accepted by the customer.

convert.title: Convert to an order?
convert.body: A draft order is created with the lines of {{number}}, and the quote closes as converted.

revise.title: Open a new revision?
revise.body: {{number}} stays as it is; a copy opens as a new draft revision.
